Excavation Permit has been issued for this location. 
 Details: This project is included in the City of Austin Transportation and Public Works 2025 Miscellaneous Streets Overlay IDIQ CLMC1070.  The Work generally consists of providing the following services, including but not limited to all necessary street preparation work as listed, including milling; crack sealing; tack coat; HMAC surface replacement areas and HMAC level up, followed by the installation of an asphalt overlay; lane and pavement markings and traffic control; and adjustment of manholes and water valve boxes. Project locations are throughout the City of Austin.  The operation will mill and pave 1.5 to 2.5 inches of the existing pavement.  We will not adjust pavement grade, add capacity, or change any roadway geometric features.  Pavement markings will be replaced as exist currently.  There are no plans associated with this maintenance work.

properties.description:
Excavation Permit has been issued for this location. 
 Details: 
Boring IDs: ATP-124. Proposed coordinates (30.225284, -97.704510)
1. Bore-Auguring will take place within southbound outside travel lane of E Riverside Dr, Between Grove Blvd and Montopolis Dr
2. A CME 55 or CME 75 will be used and will drill to the depth of 70 feet. approx.
3. Approximately 20-25 feet will be used for the ROW work zone.
4. Dimensions (L x W, in feet) of all individual cuts: The proposed work consists of geotechnical borings involving drilling 1 hole (ATP-124) with approximately 4 to 6 inches in diameter through the pavement for soil sampling. properties.name: BLOOMFIELD DR
properties.description:
Excavation Permit has been issued for this location. 
 Details: This project is included in the City of Austin Transportation and Public Works 2025 Miscellaneous Streets Overlay IDIQ CLMC1070.  The Work generally consists of providing the following services, including but not limited to all necessary street preparation work as listed, including milling; crack sealing; tack coat; HMAC surface replacement areas and HMAC level up, followed by the installation of an asphalt overlay; lane and pavement markings and traffic control; and adjustment of manholes and water valve boxes. Project locations are throughout the City of Austin.  The operation will mill and pave 1.5 to 2.5 inches of the existing pavement.  We will not adjust pavement grade, add capacity, or change any roadway geometric features.  Pavement markings will be replaced as exist currently.  There are no plans associated with this maintenance work.

properties.name: LAGUNA DR
properties.description:
Excavation Permit has been issued for this location. 
 Details: Excavation will occur within the Laguna Drive public right-of-way at the Granada Drive intersection, primarily within the paved travel lanes, with localized utility and service excavation extending toward the curb/ROW as required. Work includes the terminal portion of the proposed 8-inch water main along Granada Drive, including the 8-inch wet connection to the existing water main at approximately Sta. 7+81, together with associated fittings, valves, service work, and appurtenances. Wastewater work at the Granada Drive/Laguna Drive intersection will include associated main, manhole, service, and tie-in work shown on the approved plans.

The plans identify this as intersection work rather than a separate longitudinal utility run along Laguna Drive, so a separate Laguna-only LF quantity is not specifically called out. The full Laguna Drive ROW at the Granada Drive intersection may be required within the active work zone for excavation, equipment, material/spoil handling, staging, access, and traffic control.

properties.name: METCALFE RD
properties.description:
Excavation Permit has been issued for this location. 
 Details: Excavation will occur within the Metcalfe Road public right-of-way from Burleson Road to Catalina Drive, including the Matador Drive intersection. Work will be performed primarily within the paved travel lanes, with localized service, manhole, valve and tie-in excavation extending toward the curb/ROW and at intersections.

Work includes approximately 772 LF of 12-inch water main (WL-C) and approximately 763 LF of 8-inch wastewater main (WWL-03 ALT), together with water and wastewater service laterals, manholes, valves, fittings, cleanouts, tie-ins and associated appurtenances.

The full 60-foot Metcalfe Road ROW may be required within the active work zone for excavation, equipment, material/spoil handling, staging, access and traffic control. The approved TCP sheets show a 60-ft ROW typical section for Metcalfe.

properties.description:
Excavation Permit has been issued for this location. 
 Details: This project is included in the City of Austin Transportation and Public Works 2025 Miscellaneous Streets Overlay IDIQ CLMC1070.  The Work generally consists of providing the following services, including but not limited to all necessary street preparation work as listed, including milling; crack sealing; tack coat; HMAC surface replacement areas and HMAC level up, followed by the installation of an asphalt overlay; lane and pavement markings and traffic control; and adjustment of manholes and water valve boxes. There are no plans associated with this maintenance work.

properties.name: BAHIA CIR
properties.description:
Excavation Permit has been issued for this location. 
 Details: Excavation will occur within the Bahia Circle public right-of-way from Catalina Drive to the cul-de-sac, primarily within the paved travel lanes, with localized service and hydrant excavation extending toward the curb/ROW as required.

Work includes approximately 185 LF of proposed 8-inch water main (WL-D), approximately 125 LF of 2-inch water service laterals consisting of four services at approximately 25 LF, 15 LF, 69 LF, and 16 LF, one fire hydrant assembly, valves, fittings, tie-ins, and associated appurtenances.

Approximately 185 LF of longitudinal mainline excavation plus approximately 125 LF of service-lateral excavation will be performed, for roughly 310 LF of excavation, excluding localized hydrant, valve, fitting, and tie-in excavations. The plans do not call out one fixed trench width for all locations; trench dimensions and pavement restoration will follow the approved plans and City of Austin standards.

The full Bahia Circle ROW may be required within the active work zone for excavation, equipment, material/spoil handling, staging, access, and traffic control.

properties.name: POND SPRINGS RD
properties.description:
Excavation Permit has been issued for this location. 
 Details: 1224 LF

46 LF Roxie

We will begin open trench excavation on Pond Springs Road at the Tributary 3 north side headwall and install 27 LF of 5' x 4' box culvert going towards the center of the Pond Springs Road. At the center of Pond Springs road, we will install a 8' x 8' manhole. Then we will install 281 LF of 5' x 4' box culvert going north of the manhole on Pond Springs road. We will install the 2nd 8' x 8' manhole at the center of Pond Springs road. We install 291 LF of 5' x 4' box culvert going north of the manhole on Pond Springs Road. We will install the 3rd 8' x 8' manhole, we will install 262 LF of 5' x 3' box culvert going north down the center of Pond Springs Road, we will install the 4th 8' x 8' manhole. We will install 251 LF  of 5' x 3' box culvert going north down the center of Pond Springs Road, then we will install the 8' x 8' junction box. We will install 46 LF of 5' x 3' box culvert going north down the center of Pond Springs Road, then we will install a 16' x 8' Junction box. The we will install 2- 5' x 2' box culverts going south toward the southern edge of pavement on Pond Springs Road. We will also install storm sewer line going down Roxie Drive. Starting at the 8' x 8' Junction box, we will install 65' LF of 18" RCP going down Roxie Drive, then install a 4' manhole. Coming off the 4' manhole towards the edge of pavement we will install 9' of 18" RCP and 1 - 10' Curb Inlet. Going off the same 4' manhole on Roxie Drive we will install 57 LF of 18" RCP and the 2nd 4' manhole. Coming off the 2nd manhole towards the edge of pavement we will install 6 LF of 18" RCP and 1 - 10' Curb Inlet. Going off the same 2nd 4' manhole down Roxie drive we will install  156 LF of 18" RCP going south of Roxie drive to the 3rd 4' manhole. Going off the 3rd 4' manhole we will install 3 LF of 18" and a 10' Curb Inlet. At the intersection of Roxie Drive and Pond Springs Road, we will install 96 LF of 8" WL, 20 LF of 12" WL, 53 LF of 2" WL, Remove 92 LF of AC WL pipe.

Work approved through SP-2024-0324D
Inspections paid through 2026 073334 000 00 SSI

properties.description:
Excavation Permit has been issued for this location. 
 Details: ***PER COORDINATION WITH 2026 090665 EX, THIS PROJECT NOT SCHEDULED TO BEGIN UNTIL SOMETIME AFTER 10/01/26 ON 12712-12925 BLOCK OF PEARCE LANE**   

Excavation will take place behind the south edge of pavement on Pearce Lane for 2200 LF until it dog legs into Pearce Lane itself. It will continue within Pearce Lane 2150 LF until it turns south back into the Pearce Lane ROW behind the edge of pavement. It will continue behind the south edge of pavement for another 600 LF until it reaches Travis County ROW. Excavation starts at the intersection of S Ross Road & Pearce Lane and ends (within COA ROW) 700 LF east of the Welsh Way & Pearce Lane intersection. We will be working within a 25' easement for the entire length of excavation

Inspections paid through 2025 066510 SSI 
Work approved on SP-2021-0209D

This is a critical segment to connect the new Rainey Street Substation to the downtown power grid, as rapid growth has proven difficult for the existing Brackenridge Substation. The project comprises installing a 9x5¿ duct bank in two sections ¿ a bore section of approximately 224 feet, located approximately 30 feet below 16th Street and an open cut section of approximately 570 feet, approximately 8 feet below 16th Street. properties.name: CATALINA DR
properties.description:
Excavation Permit has been issued for this location. 
 Details: Excavation Location:
Excavation will take place primarily within the paved travel lane of Catalina Drive for installation of the proposed 8-inch water main (WL-B). Additional localized excavation will occur for water-service connections, valves, hydrant connections, and tie-ins. The work is generally within the roadway/travel lane; driveway access and sidewalk access will be maintained in accordance with the approved TCP. The Catalina TCP specifically establishes a roadway work zone and detour configuration.

Cuts / Excavation Dimensions:
The proposed 8-inch WL-B along Catalina Drive extends from approximately Sta. 1+00 to Sta. 9+40, for approximately 840 LF of longitudinal roadway excavation.

The mainline trench is anticipated to be approximately 3 feet wide, subject to actual field conditions, shoring requirements, and existing utilities. The specifications require waterline trench clearance of 6¿12 inches beyond each side of the pipe/coupling.
In addition to the mainline excavation, the plans show 8 water-service excavations/connections along this section of Catalina:
16 LF service
25 LF service
24 LF service
16 LF service
25 LF service
22 LF service
16 LF service
26 LF service
